# Arnab Designs — Arnab Shaw (arnabdzns)

> Arnab Shaw, known online as **arnabdzns** / **Arnab Designs**, is a
> budget-friendly senior **graphic designer, brand identity designer, and
> UI/UX designer** based in **Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India**, with
> roots in **West Bengal**. He designs premium brand identities, posters,
> social and campaign creatives, **esports / livestream / tournament visual
> systems**, portfolio websites, and launch pages, and ships frontend builds
> in **Next.js**. He serves creators, founders, studios, agencies, growing
> startups, and online communities across India and worldwide.
>
> This website ( https://arnabdzns.com ) was designed and engineered by
> **Amon Sharma** (web developer, frontend engineer) on Next.js 16.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Arnab Shaw / Arnab Designs do?
Brand identity, graphic design, UI/UX, esports & livestream visuals,
portfolio sites, landing pages, and Next.js frontend development.

### Where is Arnab based?
Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Originally from West Bengal.
Works remotely with clients across India and worldwide.

### Is Arnab budget-friendly?
Yes. Arnab is known for premium presentation at honest, budget-friendly
pricing — especially for creators, streamers, and small founder teams.

### What do you need to get started?
A short brief, your goals, the audience you want to reach, and any
references or brand materials you already trust are enough to start.
Rough notes are fine — direction can be shaped together.

### What if more revisions are needed?
Every project includes focused revision rounds so the direction can be
refined without losing momentum. If scope grows beyond the original plan,
work continues with a clear add-on structure rather than vague expansion.

### How long does a typical project take?
Smaller updates and focused design passes can move quickly; full
portfolio sites, launch pages, and broader brand systems usually take
one to three weeks depending on scope. A clear timeline is shared
before work begins.

### Does Arnab only design, or also build the site?
Both. Projects can stay at the design and direction stage, or move
through full frontend implementation in Next.js so the final
experience matches the intended polish more closely.

### What kind of projects are the best fit?
Portfolio websites, launch pages, personal brand sites, esports and
livestream visual systems, and premium marketing experiences that need
better hierarchy, presentation, and frontend polish.

### Can Arnab help if the copy or direction still feels rough?
Yes. A polished brief is not required to get useful help.

### Who built arnabdzns.com?
**Amon Sharma** (web developer / frontend engineer), on Next.js 16
with Tailwind CSS, custom motion, and a hand-crafted reveal system.
Find Amon's work at https://github.com/Amon20044.
